declaration: Targeted official v5 acquisition; not a downloaded-case manifest
selection_rule: Reuse the already-consulted development/demo patient; never select a fresh final-evaluation case to resolve access trouble.
requested_files: Selected baseline exam structural T1/T1c/T2/FLAIR images
Matching b-values with verified volume count and exam/release mapping

source_processing_claims.v5_dwi_geometry: Original orientation and spacing after DICOM conversion and FSL eddy; no further processing of DTI_eddy_noreg claimed by the version-5 note.
source_processing_claims.eddy: Collection reports FSL 6.0.2 with outlier replacement enabled.
source_processing_claims.topup: Collection explicitly reports TOPUP correction off.
source_processing_claims.structural: Collection describes nonlinear registration/resampling to 1-mm T2/FLAIR space and skull stripping; this does not place native DTI_eddy_noreg on the structural grid.
source_processing_claims.patient_level_pipeline_qc: Unverified until exact exam files and processing provenance are available.

required_checks: Exact exam identifier and release-specific file paths
DWI 4D volume count equals b-value and b-vector counts
Finite b-values/vectors, b0 handling and non-b0 norms
Source gradient convention, handedness and image-axis frame
Per-exam rotated-gradient provenance from released eddy output
Independent physical DWI-to-structural alignment and coverage QC

clinical_metadata_cutoff: Unknown-timed molecular/pathology and postoperative fields remain unavailable to the preoperative planner.
unavailable_fields: Official per-exam imaging inventory and file hashes
Exact baseline exam path and original image/header bytes
Per-exam rotated b-vector file and gradient convention verification
DWI-to-structural registration and patient preprocessing QC
